definitions.explanation: Having a strong personal character or style that stands out from others. Generally positive, suggesting someone or something is memorably different rather than merely odd.

examples.japanese: {個性的|こせいてき}な⟦ファッション→ファッション：11167_fasshon⟧だ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: That's a distinctive style of fashion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{個性的|こせいてき}な⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧で、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: He has such a distinctive voice that you can recognize him right away.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ギャラリー→ギャラリー：10833_gyararii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{個性的|こせいてき}な⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{見|み}ていて→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{飽|あ}きない→飽きる：01815_akiru⟧。
examples.english: This gallery has many distinctive works, so it never gets boring to look at.

notes:
USAGE:
{個性的|こせいてき} is generally used as a compliment, praising uniqueness and originality. However, it can sometimes be used as a polite or indirect way to say something is unusual or eccentric, depending on tone and context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個性的|こせいてき}な⟦ファッション→ファッション：11167_fasshon⟧ (distinctive fashion)
- {個性的|こせいてき}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (unique person)
- {個性的|こせいてき}な⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧ (distinctive work)
- {個性的|こせいてき}な⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧ (unique flavor)
- {個性的|こせいてき}な⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧ (distinctive shop)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {個性的|こせいてき}: distinctive, unique (emphasizes personal character)
- ⟦ユニーク→ユニーク：11393_yuniiku⟧: unique (loanword, often means interesting or one-of-a-kind)
- ⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧: peculiar, distinctive (can be positive or neutral)
- ⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: unusual, strange (more neutral or slightly negative)
